## Copilot review overview ### 🔵 Needs a closer look Add cursor-repeat guards to both pagination implementations to prevent hangs on malformed or replayed responses. **Review effort:** Lite **Findings:** None
Resolved since last review (2) - [Move hostname options before graphql to support GHES](#discussion_r4064687646) - [Place gh api hostname flags before the graphql endpoint](#discussion_r4064687609)
Previously missed (2) In code that hasn't changed since last review
Generated helper can loop forever on repeated pagination cursors `scripts/​authoring-owner-provenance.mjs:633` The generated helper has the same unbounded pagination loop: a malformed/replayed GraphQL response with `hasNextPage: true` and an already-seen cursor causes repeated requests forever instead of the documented fail-closed `not-found` result. Mirror the cursor-repeat guard when regenerating this artifact.
Pagination loop fails to reject repeated cursors `src/​scripts/​authoring-owner-provenance.mts:775` The pagination loop only checks that `endCursor` is non-empty. If a malformed/replayed GraphQL response returns `hasNextPage: true` with a cursor already seen, this calls the same page indefinitely instead of failing closed as incomplete evidence, so the CLI can hang rather than return `not-found`. Track previously requested cursors and reject repeats before issuing the next request.
